body: > [!IMPORTANT] > Actions on the floating card most likely won't bring Kaipu to the front when the user is in another app. That is the main case this PR exists for. **Reviewed changes** I reviewed the whole PR: the new `RecordingReadyWindow` manager, its IPC contract and preload bridge, the card window's renderer entry, the main-window hand-off routing, the recording page's ask-or-fall-back logic, and the hub's new `lastTakeDisplayId()`. - **Floating window manager**: `main/recording/recording-ready-window.ts` copies the capture toast's lifecycle. It creates the window lazily, presents it once the renderer reports ready, accepts IPC only from its own sender, and uses `destroy()` at quit. Unlike the toast, it is focusable, has no timer, and resizes to the height the card reports. - **Contract**: `shared/types/recording-ready.ts` defines the payload, actions and hand-off, and parses everything that crosses IPC. A `satisfies` pins its destinations to Prepare's `DestinationId`. - **Recording page**: `useFloatingReadyCard` asks main once per `location.key`, after the probe settles. The in-app card shows only when main answers `false` or the invoke rejects. - **Hand-off routing**: `useRecordingReadyHandOffs` in `AppRoot` maps a hand-off to `preparePath`, `editorPathFor` or the library detail route. - **Display choice**: the hub records the take's display from the area, the countdown region or the screen source. The window falls back to the display under the cursor.   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog-v2/5?action=fix&review_id=5730802425) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog-v2/5?action=fix-approved&review_id=5730802425) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog-v2/actions/runs/41362567509/job/125015871110) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)
